Text: The application must comply with Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations by requiring developers to integrate identity verification and transaction monitoring workflows that activate during high-value purchase attempts or suspicious customer activity patterns; developers must implement customer risk assessment scoring, transaction flagging for unusual orders, and documented procedures for reporting suspicious activities to appropriate financial authorities when thresholds are exceeded.
Label: Legal

Text: The system must adhere to the Digital Services Act (DSA) requirements by implementing developer-accessible transparency mechanisms that provide users with clear explanations of algorithmic recommendation systems influencing product suggestions and search rankings; developers must enable users to understand why specific products are recommended and provide functionality for users to opt out of personalized recommendations during product discovery workflows.
Label: Legal

Text: The e-commerce application must comply with the Bribery Act and corruption prevention standards by implementing developer-configured controls that prevent the application from being used to facilitate illicit payments, facilitation fees, or corrupt transactions between merchants and government officials; developers must implement transaction screening rules that flag and block suspicious payment patterns associated with high-risk jurisdictions or customer profiles flagged for corruption risk.
Label: Legal

Text: The application must conform to the Federal Trade Commission Act (FTC Act) Section 5 deceptive practices standards by requiring developers to implement accurate product representation systems where all product descriptions, pricing displays, and promotional claims are verified before customer display; developers must maintain audit trails of marketing content modifications and provide mechanisms for customers to report misleading representations encountered during shopping workflows.
Label: Legal

Text: The system must comply with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) by implementing developer-managed consent recording systems that explicitly log customer opt-in and opt-out preferences before any marketing communications are sent via SMS, email, or automated calls; developers must ensure that communication systems respect user preferences established during registration or subsequent preference management workflows, with documented evidence of consent available for compliance audits.
Label: Legal

Text: The e-commerce platform must adhere to cross-border data transfer regulations including the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) by requiring developers to implement geographic data residency controls that ensure personal data collected from European Union users during registration and purchasing activities remains within EU data centers or is transferred only through compliant mechanisms; developers must configure data transfer documentation and maintain records of all third-party processors handling cross-border customer data.
Label: Legal

Text: The application must comply with consumer protection standards regarding automated decision-making by implementing developer-controlled logging and transparency mechanisms that track when system decisions such as account suspension, purchase restrictions, or fraud flags automatically impact customer checkout experiences; developers must provide customers with explanations for automated decisions and documented appeal mechanisms allowing users to contest system-generated restrictions on their transactions.
Label: Legal

Text: The system must adhere to the Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce (E-SIGN) Act by ensuring that all contractual interactions between customers and the e-commerce platform—including purchase agreements, returns policies, and terms of service—can be executed and documented electronically; developers must implement digital record retention systems that preserve all transaction agreements and provide customers with downloadable proof of electronic signature completion for checkout and account modifications.
Label: Legal

Text: The e-commerce application must comply with the CAN-SPAM Act requirements by implementing developer-configurable email marketing controls that ensure all promotional communications sent to customers include accurate header information, functional unsubscribe mechanisms, and honor customer opt-out preferences within ten business days; developers must maintain suppression lists preventing messaging to opted-out users and log all customer preference changes triggered through email communication workflows.
Label: Legal

Text: The platform must conform to the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) safe harbor provisions by implementing developer-accessible notice-and-takedown procedures where merchants and external parties can report copyrighted content, counterfeit goods, or infringing intellectual property in product listings; developers must maintain documented procedures for receiving infringement notices, removing flagged content, and notifying affected merchants within defined timeframes to maintain platform liability protections.
Label: Legal

Text: The system must comply with VAT and Sales Tax collection obligations by implementing developer-configured tax calculation engines that automatically compute and collect appropriate consumption taxes during checkout based on customer geographic location, shipping address, and product classification; developers must ensure that tax amounts are transparently displayed before payment authorization and that transaction records include tax calculation details for compliance with multi-jurisdictional reporting requirements applicable to cross-border e-commerce operations.
Label: Legal
